SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE purchase_ts >= '2024-01-01'
  AND purchase_ts < '2024-02-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'canceled'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS category_count FROM products

SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY product_count DESC

SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY user_count DESC

SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_ts) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE purchase_ts >= '2024-01-01' AND purchase_ts < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, user_id ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4
)

SELECT p.category
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_sales,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) /
        (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items),
        2
    ) AS pct_of_total
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.purchase_ts) AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS monthly_sales,
    SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (
        ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.purchase_ts)
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.purchase_ts)
ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT
  1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS ratio
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY user_id
)

SELECT
    p.category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count,
    AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_unit_price
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY order_count DESC

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', purchase_ts) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'H1'
    ELSE 'H2'
  END AS half,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE strftime('%Y', purchase_ts) = '2024'
GROUP BY half
ORDER BY half

SELECT AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS item_count
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
)

SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY user_count DESC
LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id)

SELECT u.state, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY u.state
ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_ts) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.category
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE purchase_ts >= '2024-01-01' AND purchase_ts < '2024-02-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) FROM products
SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items

SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY product_count DESC, category

SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY user_count DESC, state

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS gmv
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY gmv DESC, p.category
LIMIT 5
SELECT substr(purchase_ts, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE purchase_ts >= '2024-01-01' AND purchase_ts < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, user_id
LIMIT 10

SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 4
)

SELECT p.category
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) DESC, p.category
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) / (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items), 2) AS pct
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT substr(o.purchase_ts, 1, 7) AS month,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(sales, 2) AS monthly_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_sales
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

WITH user_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        4
    ) AS ratio
FROM user_orders

SELECT p.category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
       ROUND(AVG(i.unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.category

SELECT CASE WHEN substr(purchase_ts, 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '06' THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS half, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE substr(purchase_ts, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY half ORDER BY half

SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM order_items

SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY user_count DESC, state
LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id)

SELECT u.state, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS gmv
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.state
ORDER BY gmv DESC, u.state

SELECT substr(purchase_ts, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY order_count DESC, month
LIMIT 1

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT p.category,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue,
           COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM order_items i
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT category,
       ROUND(revenue / order_count, 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM category_sales
WHERE order_count > 0
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC, category
LIMIT 1
